edits.front: Edit this character concept art (a front view). Make exactly these changes: 1) Remove the long brass-and-glass flamethrower lance completely, and remove the ribbed copper hose that loops from the tank down behind her legs and up to the lance: show her legs, the apron and the grey background where they were. 2) Her left arm (the arm on the RIGHT side of the image, its hand holding the lance): make it hang straight down, relaxed, a little away from her hip, the open four-fingered clawed hand beside her thigh, the cloth wrap on the upper arm kept. 3) Her right arm (on the LEFT side of the image): it hangs straight down, relaxed, a little away from her hip and clear of the notebook. 4) Her long tail: it must NOT curl out to the side of the image at all. It goes straight back away from the viewer, directly behind her body, so from the front it is hidden behind her; at most a little of it shows low between her legs. The left part of the image beside her shows only the grey background. 5) Remove the floor and the shadow under her: she stands on nothing, on the plain grey background. Keep everything else exactly the same: the same salamander woman, her short rounded feminine face with the big amber slit-pupil eyes, lashes and wide toothy grin, her black-purple skin with glowing orange spots, the orange throat and belly, the translucent fin-crest with dark fin rays and its glowing spiky orange edge running from her brow down her neck and spine, the cracked brass goggles pushed up on the crest, the copper tank on her back with its handle and iron straps, the brown leather vest-corset with its lacing, the bandolier of small glowing vials with skull labels across her chest, the torn red apron, the scorched notebook hanging on its chain at her hip, the cloth wraps on her upper arms, her clawed four-toed feet with orange claws, all colours, the painted art style and line work, the framing, scale and position of the figure, and a plain light grey background with no floor and no shadow.
edits.side: Edit this character concept art (a pure side view of her left side, facing left). Make exactly these changes: 1) Remove the long brass-and-glass flamethrower lance completely, and remove the ribbed copper hose that loops from the tank down to the lance: show her legs, the apron, the tail and the grey background where they were. 2) Show only ONE arm, the near one: it hangs straight down, relaxed, at her side, the open four-fingered clawed hand beside the middle of her thigh. 3) The other arm must not be visible at all: it is completely hidden behind her torso and hip. Nothing reaches out in front of her body: in front of her chest and belly there is only the grey background. 4) Her long tail: it leaves the base of her spine and goes straight back to the right, sloping gently down in one smooth, almost straight line until its tip lies just above the ground at the right of the picture, with no loop, no upward curl and no hook; the tip ends inside the picture with grey background around it, the fin along its top and the orange underside with dark blotches kept. 5) Remove the floor and the shadow under her: she stands on nothing, on the plain grey background.
